BA-03 sandbox: a revision history exists only for commits applied from this unit on; for an earlier commit without its revision the emulation is unavailable (UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY); the benchmark measures about 0.55 s per sandboxed read for 10 commits over 5 facts on the local TypeDB, no threshold is normative
a projection reset also clears its quarantine (its facts are gone); the drift detector release happens only after a reconciling comparison

NCR-C4-002 Jena: the C2 marking port (c2/gateway.py RegistrationAndMarkingPolicy, MarkingAuthorizationPort) still passes a legacy MarkingSet clearance; the consumer tests compose it through c4_projection_fixture.ClassificationJena, which reads that clearance as the canonical clearance of its classification level. Migrating C2 to the canonical marking is NCR-C6-012 (NCP-U08), not NCP-U05

NCR-C4-002 Jena: a stored marking that no longer resolves or matches its markingRef withholds the resource (MARKING_DENIED on JSON-LD), so a content-side corruption never discloses existence; an unresolvable clearance is MARKING_UNRESOLVED

NCR-C4-002 SHACL: config.ttl declares exactly the five endpoints option 1 names (sparql, query, update, data, shacl); the --mem default also had the dataset-level endpoint, get (gsp-r) and patch, which no code or test uses (grep of ocor-runtime, scripts, spikes, deploy)

NCR-C4-002 SHACL: every IRI subject of a provenance document must be a node of a section 3.6 class (it carries the marking and the commit of the publication); untyped blank nodes are allowed; a published node replaces the previous triples of the same node

Local dev observation: the governed Compose starts Fuseki with the image default -Xmx4G inside a 2 GiB memory limit; the SHACL cases raise the allocation rate and an ad hoc dev run of 872 cases was OOM-killed once (exit 137). With the -Xmx1G of the CI resource profile (scripts/bootstrap_ci_environment.py ci_resources, used by CI and by the local lane campaign) nine repeated SHACL runs plateau at 1.1-1.2 GiB without OutOfMemoryError: allocation churn, not a leak; at 7d5c4c1 (--mem) the same ad hoc set peaked at 727 MiB. No tracked change; ad hoc dev runs use the same profile as an untracked override

reports/tests/test_fuseki_local_identity.py: 3 cases fail identically on main bfb2ca8 and on the unit head (historical acquisition pinned to an earlier lock); not in the CI steps, not caused by NCP-U05
product_orientation: the watermark ledger, the quarantine and the checkpoints are durable PostgreSQL tables behind ports, outside the projection stores, so a production deployment keeps them across restarts and a projection rebuild
the rebuild source is the canonical TerminusDB C3 store (TerminusDBC3Service), the production source of truth, not a test double
the SHACL validation uses the SHACL service of the pinned Fuseki of the stack (NCP-U05-FUSEKI-SHACL-SERVICE option 1): no new dependency and no in-process SHACL engine to replace later

the canonical marking evaluator reads the C1 IR MarkingSchemeDefinition, so production schemes plug in without changing C4; the C2 marking port stays on the legacy MarkingSet until NCR-C6-012 (NCP-U08)
the TypeDB sandbox is a disposable database of the same TypeDB, bounded in number (max_sandboxes), so the BA-03 emulation is a real adapter capability subject to conformance tests
